mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market shock that triggers a policy response and risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has been above 10% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand collapse, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary labor market regime (defined by UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS decline for 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the short term due to heightened economic uncertainty, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the recessionary labor market regime condition.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has been below 90 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has been below 1200 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 256.0 and a decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.04% signals an inflationary shock with accommodative policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 256.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.04% fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
